projectIntro: Selected projects spanning full-stack platforms, API integrations, and interactive web applications.

restaurant.title: Restaurant Insights
restaurant.description: A multilingual platform for restaurant management and analytics, with restaurant and branch onboarding.
restaurant.details: Built with Next.js, Supabase, Drizzle, and oRPC. The public code includes restaurant and branch setup, business-hours forms, menu data models, and shared authentication and onboarding checks.

remarcable.title: Remarcable Product Search
remarcable.description: A responsive product catalogue with live search, category filters, and multi-tag filtering.
remarcable.details: A Django API and Next.js frontend with filters synchronized to the URL, sortable results, mobile product cards, and loading and error states. Django QuerySets optimize related data; production uses PostgreSQL with Heroku and Vercel deployments.

sips.title: Sips Cafe
sips.description: A bubble tea ordering platform with menu browsing, payments, and administration tools.
sips.details: A BCIT team project using C#, ASP.NET Core MVC, and Azure SQL. Features include PayPal payments, user and order management, authentication and authorization, email verification, and Google reCAPTCHA.

movie.title: Movie Mania
movie.description: Explore movies from TMDB and organize favorites and a personal watchlist.
movie.details: Built with React and Redux for shared state, Axios for TMDB requests, and React Router for navigation. The project supports adding and removing movies from favorites and watchlists.

deck.title: Deck Master
deck.description: An online store with product browsing, order handling, and PayPal payments.
deck.details: A C# MVC application backed by SQL. The project combines storefront pages, user and role administration, transaction views, and a PayPal checkout flow.

billing.title: Express Billing
billing.description: A billing application with authenticated access and MongoDB-backed billing records.
billing.details: Built with Node.js and Express, using Passport for authentication and MongoDB for storing billing information. The application supports publishing and managing customer bills.
